description: Two trigger buffers, each holding an arming until the next gate arrives and letting that one gate through

params.text: Arms that channel by hand, so the next gate at its input is passed on

inputs.text: A rising edge arms the first channel; if its gate is already high the arming takes effect once that gate has fallen
A rising edge arms the second channel; with nothing patched it takes the first channel's Arm signal
The gates offered to the first channel's output, of which one is passed each time the channel is armed
The gates offered to the second channel's output; with nothing patched it takes the first channel's In signal

outputs.text: Carries 10V for one gate from its input once the channel has been armed, and 0V until it is armed again

notes: both channels work polyphonically, arming and passing each channel of the cable separately
a channel passes nothing until it is armed: with Arm on Load unticked both outputs stay at 0V when the patch is loaded, until the Arm button is pressed or a trigger reaches the Arm input
menu: Arm on Load — both channels come up armed every time the module is loaded or reset, instead of waiting to be armed
Save Default — writes the present Arm on Load setting into ML_Modules.json in the Rack user folder, so new Trigger Buffer modules start with it
